adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb the migration builds raw SQL with string interpolation: `execute "INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts (host, ...) VALUES ('#{h}', ...)"`, where `h` comes from splitting the old `site_settings.value` (`val.split("\n")`). This is unescaped/unparameterized: a host value containing a single quote will break the SQL (or worse), and blank lines from the split are not filtered/stripped, so `''` can be inserted into `embeddable_hosts.host` (allowed by the DB schema), bypassing model validation and leaving invalid data behind.
